Description.value: Round minimap in the top-left corner, drawn from your own explored map. Turns with your view, shows the same icons as the M map (traders, bedroll, land claim, quests, waypoints, vehicles...), and zooms out with speed in vehicles. F2 / F3 zoom, Delete toggles, F5 to move it and rebind its keys in game. Client-side only. Requires EAC off (DLL mod).
